title: Semiparametric Efficiency for Entropic Optimal Transport under Structured Distribution Shift
abstract: arXiv:2611.27261v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Can structural information improve estimation of entropic optimal transport (EOT), and when is the gain zero? We study a fixed-dimensional exponential density ratio model (DRM) with a nonparametric baseline, compact support, and fixed positive regularization. At positive limiting sampling fractions, an exact projection identity quantifies the variance gain from the restriction. The pooled empirical-likelihood estimator attains the restricted bound and supports asymptotically valid confidence intervals when the bound is positive. Even under correct specification, the gain can be zero and can shrink as the tilt space expands. The same projection residual determines direction-specific first-order bias under local misspecification. When both samples grow and the target fraction vanishes, a zero first-order tilt derivative can leave source fluctuations and quadratic tilt error as the leading terms. translated_title: 结构化分布偏移下熵正则最优传输的半参数有效性
translated_abstract: 结构信息能否改进熵正则最优传输（EOT）的估计，以及何时增益为零？我们研究了一个固定维数的指数密度比模型（DRM），该模型具有非参数基线、紧支撑集和固定的正则化系数。在正的极限抽样比例下，一个精确的投影恒等式量化了来自限制约束的方差增益。混合经验似然估计量达到了受约束界的水平，并且当该界为正时支持渐近有效的置信区间。即使在模型正确设定的情形下，增益也可能为零，且随着倾斜空间的扩大而缩小。在局部错误设定下，同一投影残差决定了方向特定的一阶偏差。当两个样本同时增长且目标比例趋近于零时，倾斜函数的一阶导数为零会导致源样本波动和二次倾斜误差成为主导项。二者的平衡产生了相变现象。
tldr: 本文通过精确投影恒等式揭示了结构约束下熵最优传输估计的方差增益何时为正、何时为零，并构造了达到该效率界的混合经验似然估计量。
en_tdlr: This paper derives an exact projection identity that characterizes when structural constraints yield positive or zero variance gains for entropic optimal transport estimation, and constructs a pooled empirical-likelihood estimator attaining the efficiency bound.
